svg.title: Separate completion and close branches of a work order
svg.desc: Separate completion and close branches of a work order. A work order links separately to material issues, labor, production completion lines, and accounting close. Completion makes finished goods available before close. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
